_auth: For a server marked adapter paw-native in config/servers.json, set PAW_HOST in .env (the PAW address). Users then sign in with their PAW login and every Lens call runs through PAW as them.
_trustProxy: Behind PAW or another TLS reverse proxy, set this to true (or the number of proxy hops) so req.secure and the Secure cookie follow X-Forwarded-Proto. Leave false when the app is reached directly.
_endSessionProcesses: Processes run as the person when their session ends (sign out or idle timeout), e.g. [{ "process": "Lens Reserve", "params": { "pAction": "ReleaseAll" } }] to hand back data reservations taken through Lenses.
